text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Biko Pegasus, we stopped by the hero base she was building.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
You're really starting to look the part!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the monitor room and armory finished, the final picture was coming into view. And then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, the recovery room is ready too. I'm so glad we found some fluffy cushions♪"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I even set up the command tent for you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now all their classified info is leaked!
Hehehe, what a brilliant evil infiltration plan, if I do say so myself~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for helping out!
Thanks to you, it's getting closer to my ideal secret base!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm really grateful to both
Turbo-senpai and Urara-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one last push!
Let's all go gather the rest of the wood we need!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara & Others
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We set out to gather the materials
needed for the finishing touches. However—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ca~ro~tene~~♪
Healthy down to my very so~u~l~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh, is it raining? Just now, a drop—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, it's thundering!?
I gotta cover my belly button~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rain that had just begun quickly gained momentum.
Thunder roared, and the wind began to howl fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, stay calm!
Let's look for a building to take shelter from the rain!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a relief there was a cafe nearby~.
We're so lucky they even let us borrow towels.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (R-rattle, rattle, rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!! Is the hero base gonna be okay!?
I'm gonna go take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai!!
It's dangerous to go out right now, please stay here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Are we just supposed to sit here and do nothing!?
The base is gonna get wrecked!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... Let's believe in them!
That's the only thing we can do right now...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Rain, you big stupid jerk, nanoda--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few hours later, as if the earlier rain had been a lie,
the sun was shining brilliantly. However—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So many got broken...
Everything's in pieces...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, what the heck~!!
I was just about to finish it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "What words should I offer her? Knowing just how hard she fought to get here, I hesitate... But—!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Carrotman Episode 41!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
" 'Invasion! Evil Clutches Approach the Hero Base'!!
The base was destroyed, and the team was scattered."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... we never gave up.
We joined forces and got things back on track!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We can do it too!
I mean... we built our base all the way up to that
completely from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Keep your head up and stand tall!
It's okay... A hero—I'm right here with you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's right!
Let's make our secret base even cooler than before!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's still stuff we can use.
Let's split up and look!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, everyone!
Let's get back to building our hero base!
choice_data_list: You're right, it can definitely be restored.
Yeah, we can definitely get things back up and running.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, everyone!
Let's get back to building our hero base!
choice_data_list: You're right, it can definitely be restored.
Yeah, we can definitely get things back up and running.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's definitely the plan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Windy-senpai!
Could you go wash these boards in the river?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bono! When you're done over there,
come give me a hand with this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never looking down, Biko Pegasus
continued tidying up. All he could do was
sincerely wish for the completion of the hero base.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No rain can fall on a passionate heart!
The ally of all, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So cooool...!
Biko, you really and truly are a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Drawing courage from Biko Pegasus, everyone pressed on with cleaning up!
